primary_key:
      - interview_scorecard_key
      business_logic: '- Begin with all rows from scheduled_interview. - Left join scheduled_interviewer on scheduled_interview_id; keep scheduled_interview rows without a match and set interviewer_user_id to NULL in that case. - Left join scorecard using the scorecard_id from scheduled_interviewer; scorecard fields remain NULL if there is no matching scorecard. - Left join interview on interview_id from scheduled_interview; interview fields remain NULL if there is no matching interview. - Set interview_name to interview.name when present; otherwise use scorecard.interview_name; if both are missing, leave it NULL; original casing and spacing are preserved. - Compute duration_interview_minutes as the minute difference between end_at and start_at (end minus start); returned as a DOUBLE, not rounded; NULL if either timestamp is NULL and may be negative if end_at precedes start_at. - Create interview_scorecard_key by concatenating scheduled_interview_id, a hyphen "-", and interviewer_user_id; represent a missing interviewer_user_id with the literal "no_interviewer".'

primary_key:

      business_logic: '- Read job-office links from staging.stg_greenhouse__job_office (uses job_id, office_id). - Read office attributes from staging.stg_greenhouse__office (uses office_id, office_name, location_name). - Inner join on office_id; only job_office rows with a matching office record are retained. - Group by job_id to produce one output row per job_id. - offices: concatenate office_name values with delimiter "; ". - locations: concatenate location_name values with delimiter "; ". - Determinism for both aggregations: - Delimiter: "; " inserted between consecutive non-NULL items; no leading/trailing delimiter. - Ordering: no explicit ordering specified; concatenation order is not guaranteed. - Duplicates: preserved; identical names appear multiple times if present in joined rows. - NULL policy: NULL values are excluded; if all aggregated values are NULL, the result is NULL. - Casing/whitespace: preserved as stored (no trimming or normalization). - Jobs without any joined office rows are excluded from the output.'
